column1: # RFC 6531 §3.2 and §3.3 widen the RFC 5321 Mailbox grammar rather than
# restating it: UTF-8 in the local part, U-labels in the domain. The official
# suite's optional/format/idn-email.json reaches both widenings with one
# address; these rows separate them, so a check landing on only the local part
# or only the domain shows up as one failing row rather than none.
# Row format: see loadVectorFile in vectors_test.go.

column3: an ASCII mailbox is an idn-email
RFC 6532 §3.1 UTF-8 in the local part
RFC 6531 widens Mailbox without dropping the "@"
RFC 5892 A.3 judged after the RFC 5891 §5.3 case mapping
RFC 5893 condition 1: an LTR label in a Bidi domain name may not open on a digit
RFC 5893 conditions 5 and 6: an LTR label in a Bidi domain name may close on EN
